name: Beta Feedback
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Beta program for Omarchy plugins: end users opt in, get a bug button inside enrolled plugins, and file reports carrying the last 10 clicks, a panel-only screenshot they annotate, and version info. Reports become GitHub issues on the plugin's repo; authors triage them, let an agent fix them on a staging branch, and testers get an update-ready notification.

barWidget.description: Bug chip: your beta enrollments, your reports and their status, and update-now buttons when a fix is ready.
